precedence_rationale: Schema defects are handled before graph analysis because malformed input cannot be safely traced.
Preservation breaches are handled before ordinary semantic repair because they constrain every legal fix.
Law family mismatches are resolved before grounding gaps when both appear on the same operation.
Grounding gaps are traced only after the target operation and law surface are structurally coherent.
determinism_policy.multi_match_tiebreak: choose the smallest target_operation_id, then smallest claim id, then smallest evidence id

failure_families.description: The rejection arises from malformed proposal structure rather than semantic state reasoning.

negative_conditions: Do not classify as schema when the candidate is well-formed and only semantically incomplete.
Do not traverse claim evidence for this family unless preservation constraints must be copied.

repair_pattern.target_selection: operation identified by rejection path or candidate_id context
repair_pattern.required_fields: exact schema path and required type or enum surface from sealed schema
repair_pattern.preservation_constraints: copy visible preserved sibling claim ids without mutation
repair_pattern.direct_example_value_policy: allowed only for structural empty containers or sealed enum ids

failure_families.description: The rejected operation is structurally valid but uses an unlawful doctrine family or companion law for the operation kind.

negative_conditions: Do not classify as law mismatch when the only issue is absent evidence support.
Do not classify as law mismatch when the proposal cannot be parsed into operations.

dependency_trace.target_claim_id: target operation claim id when present

repair_pattern.target_selection: operation identified by rejection path, never a sibling operation
repair_pattern.required_fields: replace or remove the unlawful law id using the sealed operation-kind doctrine table
repair_pattern.preservation_constraints: copy visible preserved sibling claim ids without mutation
repair_pattern.direct_example_value_policy: law ids must come from the doctrine digest, not from proposer text

failure_families.description: The rejected operation lacks a lawful evidence or support edge binding to the trigger graph.

negative_conditions: Do not fabricate an evidence id when no supporting edge exists.
Do not use prior-only evidence to ground a trigger-only revision unless the operation kind permits it.

dependency_trace.target_claim_id: trigger claim reached by the rejected operation

repair_pattern.required_fields: grounding evidence path and basis trigger path when required
repair_pattern.grounding_evidence_ids: ids reachable from trigger graph support edges for the target claim
repair_pattern.preservation_constraints: copy visible preserved sibling claim ids without mutation
repair_pattern.direct_example_value_policy: forbidden; evidence ids must already exist in sealed graph inputs

failure_families.description: The rejected proposal mutates, drops, or fails to acknowledge a sibling claim that must remain stable.

negative_conditions: Do not convert a preservation breach into a broad rewrite instruction.
Do not emit a repair that changes a preserved claim's assertion, confidence, law family, or evidence.

dependency_trace.target_claim_id: the touched or omitted preserved sibling claim

repair_pattern.target_selection: operation touching the preserved claim, or the preserved_items aggregate when no operation path is present
repair_pattern.required_fields: preserved_items and remove_or_replace for the unlawful operation when applicable
repair_pattern.preservation_constraints: all visible preserved sibling claim ids from prior graph and verifier ids
repair_pattern.direct_example_value_policy: preserved ids must come from sealed graph or verifier feedback

companion_laws.name: halt_on_ungroundable_repair
companion_laws.rule: If no grounding evidence id or support edge exists in the sealed trigger graph for the target claim, the diagnostic loop must halt instead of emitting a repair instruction.
forbidden_outputs: fallback to prior-only evidence without doctrine permission
repair instructions with empty grounding_evidence_ids for a grounding-required operation

companion_laws.name: repair_scope_minimality
companion_laws.rule: A repair instruction must target the smallest operation, field, evidence id set, or preservation id set sufficient to close the verifier violation.
forbidden_outputs: multiple operation targets when one operation is identified
claim ids or evidence ids outside the sealed graph id universe
new proposer budget consumption before repair instruction emission

gate_requirements_for_next_phase: Invariant tests must prove classifier determinism against these canonical codes and precedence rules.
Invariant tests must prove tracer outputs ids only from the allowed sources declared here.
Invariant tests must prove repair generation obeys both companion laws.
Invariant tests must prove retry proposer calls occur only after repair instruction emission.
